candidates.explanation: The size check uses `<` instead of `>`. Any file smaller than file.maxFileSize is rejected with 413 'File too large'. A 200 KB file is smaller than the limit, so it is rejected. A 20 MB file is larger than the limit, so it passes the check and gets a signed URL. The comparison is inverted.

fix.description: Invert the comparison so that only files larger than the maximum are rejected: use `file.fileSize > (maxFileSize || 0)`. If maxFileSize is unset, the `|| 0` fallback would reject everything, so skip the check when no limit is configured.

candidates.explanation: The size check uses `<` instead of `>`. Any file smaller than file.maxFileSize is rejected with 413 'File too large'. A 200 KB file is smaller than the limit, so it is rejected. A 20 MB file is larger than the limit, so it passes the check and gets a signed URL. The comparison is inverted.

fix.description: Invert the comparison so that only files larger than the maximum are rejected: use `file.fileSize > (maxFileSize || 0)`. If maxFileSize is unset, the `|| 0` fallback would reject everything, so skip the check when no limit is configured.
